state_profile.voting_summary: Arkansas votes mostly early in person (72% of the 2024 vote), with a quarter on election day and mail limited to excuse-required absentees (2%). Polls close at 8:30 p.m. Eastern; early and absentee votes are released first, then election day precincts report through the evening, and the state is effectively complete by midnight. The modes differ little politically (early votes ran R+30 and election day R+35), so margins barely move as the night progresses.
